title: Turn Context v1
description: What a real provider would receive when interpreting one turn — compact, bounded, never raw CAD geometry, never the full turn history. See docs/bible/14-conversation/375-turn-context-model.md, 387-context-window-policy.md, and backend/jewelmind/conversation/schemas.py::TurnContext. Built by build_turn_context(); never constructed by hand.

recentAcceptedChanges.description: Bounded to MAX_RECENT_TURNS_IN_CONTEXT (a turn-count bound, not an invented token budget).

compactConversationSummary.description: A ConversationSummary (see conversation-summary.schema.json), present only once the session has more turns than fit in the recent window; null otherwise.
